hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; P="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; aec() { ( r="${RELAYKIT_RECORDS#"${RELAYKIT_RECORDS%%[![:space:]]*}"}"; case "$r" in /*|'') ;; *) export RELAYKIT_RECORDS="$P/$r";; esac; cd / && pp=$(python3 -I -c "import os,sys; p=os.path.join(os.path.realpath(sys.argv[1]),''); print(os.pathsep.join(e for e in os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH','').split(os.pathsep) if e and not os.path.join(os.path.realpath(e),'').startswith(p)))" "$P") || exit 1; if [ -n "$pp" ]; then export PYTHONPATH="$pp"; else unset PYTHONPATH; fi; python3 -m aec "$@" ); }; aec code-impact --help 2>/dev/null | grep -q -- --exit-code || { echo 'Telosmith hook: the installed aec has no code-impact --exit-code; install Telosmith v0.5.0 or later (the commit your CI job pins)' >&2; exit 1; }; aec edges "$P" -o "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || { rm -f "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl"; echo 'Telosmith hook: could not refresh .aec/edges.jsonl; skipped the records check' >&2; exit 1; }; aec check "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" --edges "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" >/dev/null || { aec check "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" --edges "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" 1>&2; exit 2; }; aec snapshot "$P" --rev HEAD -o "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; out=$(aec code-impact "$P/.aec/records.jsonl" "$P/.aec/hook-before.jsonl" "$P/.aec/edges.jsonl" --exit-code 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" '(Telosmith: stale/needs_review lines are status changes; structural pointer lines are candidates for attention and change no status.)' >&2; exit 2; }
